sql.predicate_in_on: SELECT SUM(w) FROM b LEFT JOIN x ON b.id=x.id AND x.v=1
sql.predicate_in_where: SELECT SUM(w) FROM b LEFT JOIN x ON b.id=x.id WHERE x.v=1
sql.exists_target: SELECT SUM(w) FROM b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM x WHERE x.id=b.id AND x.v=1)
sql.distinct_weight: SELECT SUM(DISTINCT w) FROM b LEFT JOIN x ON b.id=x.id AND x.v=1
